units.source_text: 千重子低下了头，脑海中浮现出水木真一的身影。

en.t: Chieko lowered her head, and the figure of Mizuki Shinichi came to mind.
It was Shinichi as he had been in childhood.

units.source_text: 画眉毛，涂口红，化妆打扮成王朝的装束，乘上了祇园节的长刀花车，这是真一的童男形象。

en.t: With his eyebrows drawn and lipstick applied, made up and dressed in court costume, riding on the Naginata float of the Gion Festival, this was Shinichi in the guise of the sacred child.

units.source_text: 当然，那个时候，千重子也是个小孩子。

en.t: Of course, at that time Chieko too was still a small child.
